0:
if [ -f /data/ledger.beancount ]; then
  echo "ledger present at /data/ledger.beancount, not seeding"
  exit 0
fi
cp /seed/ledger.beancount /data/ledger.beancount
echo "seeded example ledger onto empty volume"

set -e
f=/var/lib/tuwunel/.registration_token
if [ ! -s "$f" ]; then
  head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' > "$f"
  echo "[matrix] generated registration token: $(cat "$f")"
  echo "[matrix] use it on the Element 'Create account' screen"
fi
# openebs-hostpath ignores fsGroup, so hand the whole data dir
# to the unprivileged Tuwunel user or it cannot write RocksDB.
chown -R 1000:1000 /var/lib/tuwunel

import os, urllib.request

# ~203KB each, so re-fetching per start is cheaper than a PVC.
BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fwartner/home-assistant-wakewords-collection/main/en"
MODELS = {
    "wheatley.tflite": f"{BASE}/wheatley/wheatley.tflite",
}
DST = "/custom"

os.makedirs(DST, exist_ok=True)
for name, url in MODELS.items():
    dest = os.path.join(DST, name)
    if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 50_000:
        print("present:", name, os.path.getsize(dest))
        continue
    print("fetching:", name)
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, dest)
    size = os.path.getsize(dest)
    if size < 50_000:
        # a 404 body would be a few hundred bytes
        raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {name} looks wrong ({size} bytes)")
    print("  got:", name, size)
print("wake words ready:", sorted(os.listdir(DST)))

apk add --no-cache libc6-compat &&
wget -qO- https://github.com/nebhale/teslamate-discovery/releases/download/v2.6.0/teslamate-discovery_2.6.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C /tmp &&
/tmp/teslamate-discovery \
  --mqtt-host mosquitto.default.svc.cluster.local \
  --mqtt-port 1883 \
  --mqtt-scheme tcp \
  --mqtt-username anonymous \
  --mqtt-password anonymous \
  --units-distance metric \
  --units-pressure metric
